design.floatText: A card floating over the main card

design.photosText: A photo in place of the initials, in the same circle. Without one, or when it doesn't load, the initials stay.
design.visibilityPrivate: Only you and the owners see this
design.emptyBody: Every empty screen says what to do next.
design.switchHint: What changes at once, with no save button
design.accentPickerCaption: How the colour will look in the app
design.qrCodeText: Always dark on white, in dark mode too. The digits under it are for typing.
design.scanCircleText: Pressing the circle turns it into the camera in the same place, and the line under it says what is happening.
design.covers: Eight covers, all drawn in the business's colour, so any colour works in light and dark. Below: choosing one, as on the profile.
design.checklistPhoto: A photo of the kitchen after cleaning
design.switcherText: Only for someone in more than one business: a list on Home, a row on the profile that opens it, and a menu on the sidebar on a computer.
design.dataTableReadHint: A wide table with nothing to choose: the keyboard reaches it, and the arrows scroll it sideways.
design.dataTableNote1: Corrected by a manager: forgot to clock out
design.dateFieldHint: Three fields of digits, never a wheel
design.chatText: Message bubbles, a row of the chat list, a day divider, a conversation's title, the composer and the new-messages pill.
design.chatImmersive: On a phone, a conversation hides the tab bar, and the composer takes its place.
design.chatSample1: Good morning. The supplier comes at 10:00, can someone meet them?
design.chatSample2: I'm already here, I'll meet them
design.chatSample3: The technician's details are here: https://www.example.com/service
design.chatSample5:
For tomorrow:
Check the second fridge
Order lemons
Close the till by 23:00
design.chatSample6: I'll be there in ten minutes
design.chatSample7: Can I swap Friday with you?
design.chatAnnounceText: A message from management is pinned to the top of its group, with "I've read it" for everyone it asks, and for its author and management how many did. While it waits for the reader it stays under the title.
design.chatAnnounceSample: From next week the till closes at 22:00
design.chatAuthorView: As its author and management see it
design.chatActionsText: Tapping a message, or the button beside it on a computer, opens what can be done with it. After deleting or removing one, "Undo" stays for 10 seconds.
design.chatComposerAnnounce: Management's composer in a group, with the switch for a message from management
design.chatPicturesText: Photos in chat: the thumbnail in a message, which opens whole in a sheet, a photo on its way, and a file no longer kept. The message itself stays.
design.chatPictureSample: This is how the kitchen looks now
design.chatAttachText: The attach button opens the phone's photo picker, and its camera too. The chosen photo is made ready on the phone and shows over the field. In a demo business the button says nothing can be attached.

method.title: How it's worked out
method.hours: Each shift counts by the hours the clock recorded, to the minute. An unpaid break comes off.
method.day: On a workday the first hours are regular: up to <ltr>8</ltr> in a 6-day week, <ltr>8.6</ltr> in a 5-day week, and <ltr>7</ltr> on the eve of Shabbat or a holiday and on a night shift. The next two hours are overtime at 125%, and the rest at 150%.
method.week: Past <ltr>42</ltr> hours a week, regular hours count as overtime too.
method.rest: Hours in the weekly rest and on holidays are 150%, and overtime in them 175% and 200%.
method.holidayPay: A holiday or election day not worked, when it was due to be a workday, is paid by the daily average of the 3 months before.
method.amounts: The amount is the hours at each rate times the hourly wage, rounded to the agora.
method.excluded: No tax, national insurance, pension, vacation, sick days or travel. The payslip decides.
method.readings: Some rules are a reading of the law for an accountant to confirm, such as rest hours past 42 hours a week. They are marked to check.
